deviations: fixest's default removed 15-16 fixed-effect singleton observations per regression, so reported N (1199, 1207, 1117) is below the full estimation sample (1214, 1222, 1133 identified in exploratory attempt-2 with |dif|<=45 and complete controls); coefficients are unaffected by singleton removal. Not changed after comparison with claims.

Anderson (2008) indices built on the full respondent sample (non_response==0): items standardized by control-group (born Jan 1956 or later) mean/SD, weighted by row sums of the inverse covariance matrix of standardized items, index re-standardized to control mean 0/SD 1; index defined only where all component items are observed (matches the paper's sample sizes).
notes: Attempt-1: variable listing. Attempt-2: checked running variable (dif = months older than Dec 1955; before1955=1 for dif>=0) and sample counts; |dif|<=45 with complete controls reproduces the paper's Ns exactly. Final: feols of outcome on before1955 + dif + dif*before1955 + female + education and ethnicity dummies | birth-month, province and surveyor FE, SEs clustered by month-year of birth (dif), uniform kernel, 45-month bandwidth.
